item.title: Iranian Foreign Minister holds phone call with UN Secretary-General
item.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi, who has traveled to New York at the head of a diplomatic delegation to attend the UN General Assembly, held a phone call with UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres upon his arrival. During the phone call, the two sides discussed and exchanged views on issues on the agenda of the UN General Assembly and the UN secretary-general’s efforts to advance international peace and security.

item.title: Iranian Foreign Ministry rejects France’s false claims over illegal activities of embassy-affiliated institute
item.description: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Republic of Iran strongly rejects the baseless and false claims concerning the educational institute affiliated with the French Embassy in Tehran, as stated in the French Foreign Ministry’s statement dated September 20, 2026. The action by law enforcement authorities to halt the illegal activities of an institute affiliated with the French Embassy in Tehran was taken pursuant to a judicial order, following the French Embassy’s persistent and prolonged disregard, over the past several years, of repeated warnings by the competent Iranian authorities regarding the necessity of legally registering the center and obtaining the required authorization for its activities. The provisions of the 1961 Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations concerning the privileges and immunities of embassies are clear, and the French Embassy is required to obtain the necessary legal permits, in accordance with the laws and regulations of the host country, for the establishment and operation of centers and institutions with cultural and educational functions. The action by law enforcement authorities to halt the illegal activities of an institute affiliated with the French Embassy in Tehran was taken pursuant to a judicial order, following the French Embassy’s persistent and prolonged disregard, over the past several years, of repeated warnings by the competent Iranian authorities regarding the necessity of legally registering the center and obtaining the required authorization for its activities. The French Embassy in Tehran’s insistence on disregarding the provisions of the Convention on Diplomatic Relations and its expectation of being exempted from the laws and regulations of the Islamic Republic of Iran are in no way acceptable. item.title: Iranian Foreign Minister arrives in New York to attend UN General Assembly
item.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi arrived in New York, the headquarters of the United Nations, on Monday afternoon at the head of a diplomatic delegation to participate in discussions at the annual session of the UN General Assembly. In addition to participating in discussions on various items on the UN General Assembly’s agenda and presenting the Islamic Republic of Iran’s positions, the foreign minister will hold talks and consultations with a large number of officials and foreign ministers attending the session. The 81st session of the UN General Assembly, under the theme “Renewing Trust in the United Nations,” will begin on Tuesday with addresses by heads of state.
item.content:encoded:

The 81st session of the UN General Assembly, under the theme “Renewing Trust in the United Nations,” will begin on Tuesday with addresses by heads of state.

Original source: https://en.mfa.gov.ir/portal/newsview/794696

On the eve of the annual session of the United Nations General Assembly, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Republic of Iran, expressing deep disgust and grave concern over the continuation of the Israeli regime’s crimes against the Palestinian people, particularly genocide, war crimes and crimes against humanity in Gaza and the West Bank, underscores the responsibility of the international community to take serious and decisive action to stop the genocide of Palestinians. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs also strongly condemns the shameless desecration of Al-Aqsa Mosque and the violation of the sanctity of Al-Buraq by the prime minister of the Israeli regime. The occupying Israeli regime, which over the past three years, with comprehensive arms, financial, political and media support from the United States and some countries claiming to uphold human rights, has committed one of the largest genocides in the history of the world in Gaza, has simultaneously resorted to the most heinous methods, including the systematic and widespread killing and torture of Palestinians in the West Bank and Gaza, to advance the sinister plan of the “colonial erasure of Palestine.” The hostage-taking of Palestinian women and children, whose number has exceeded 10,000, and their torture in horrific prisons, which has resulted in the martyrdom of dozens of them and the amputation and disability of hundreds of others, undoubtedly constitute war crimes and crimes against humanity. The fact that, on average, at least three Palestinian detainees are martyred under torture every month is not only evidence of the apartheid and colonial nature of the Israeli regime, but also indicative of the hypocrisy and moral decay of the regime’s supporters, who remain indifferent to the blatant violations of human rights and international humanitarian law by the occupying regime. The Islamic Republic of Iran, while strongly condemning the crimes of the Israeli regime in Gaza and the West Bank, stresses that the immunity granted to this regime by the United States, including through the intimidation and sanctioning of judges of international courts and activists and human rights rapporteurs advocating for the Palestinian people, must in no way obstruct the pursuit of justice and freedom for Palestine or the demand for the prosecution and punishment of Israeli criminals. The Israeli regime’s occupation, terrorism, lawlessness and unprecedented crimes in occupied Palestine, as well as its aggressions and crimes against the countries of the region over the past eight decades, have undoubtedly inflicted the most severe blows on the credibility and standing of the United Nations and international law. The fact that the Israeli regime ranks at the top among violators of United Nations resolutions, and that the greatest number of Security Council vetoes have been cast with the aim of preventing action against Israel’s lawlessness and crimes, is in itself indicative of the role of this regime in eroding the credibility and standing of the United Nations. Now that the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly has rightly been dedicated to the theme of “Restoring Trust” among countries in the Organization, it is the duty of every responsible state to place support for the rights of the Palestinian people, particularly their right to self-determination, and assistance in freeing them from 80 years of occupation, apartheid and colonialism, at the forefront of its agenda as an international legal obligation and a moral and humanitarian mission. Achieving this requires immediate action to stop the genocide of Palestinians and prevent the expansion of occupation and the seizure of Palestinian land, deliver humanitarian aid to the people of Gaza, and hold the perpetrators accountable and punish the criminals.

item.title: Iran condemns terrorist attack on mosque in Pakistan’s Kohat
item.description: Esmail Baghaei, Spokesperson for the Iranian Foreign Ministry, strongly condemned the terrorist attack on a mosque near a police facility in the city of Kohat, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province, Pakistan, during Friday prayers, which left dozens of people dead and injured. Baghaei extended his condolences to the families of those killed, as well as to the government and Muslim people of neighboring Pakistan. Emphasizing the Islamic Republic of Iran’s principled position of unequivocally condemning all forms of terrorism and violent extremism, the Foreign Ministry spokesperson stressed that terrorist and violent acts targeting civilians and security forces have absolutely no justification. Baghaei also stressed the need to strengthen cooperation and coordination among regional countries to effectively and continuously combat terrorism.

item.title: Baghaei: World Will Not Be Fooled by US False Narratives Hypocritical Propaganda
item.description: Iranian Foreign Ministry Spokesman Esmail Bagaei, in a post on X, said the world would not be fooled by Washington’s “false narratives and hypocritical propaganda,” criticizing the US for waging an economic war against Iran while making a show of restricting Iranian officials from shopping at a wholesale store in New York during the upcoming UN General Assembly.
